messages:
anya: Heads up — our Uptown Demo Circuit starts next Wed. Need final checklist: swag, speaker submissions, power, badge print. Can folks confirm owners?

matt: I'm +1 for taking swag ops. Where are boxes currently?

lina: Warehouse A — box IDs: BOX-4321, BOX-4322. Shipped ETA Tue 5pm. Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784

matt: copying over manifests to S3: `aws s3 cp ./swag_manifest.csv s3://rw-marketing/swags/uptown-2026.csv` :thumbsup: 

chris: I'll handle AV / foldable kiosk test. Need adapter list — does venue provide HDMI? @anya do you have the venue tech sheet?

anya: yes attached in drive: https://drive.google.com/uptown-tech-sheet (perm: marketing@redwood.com). Quick notes: only 1 HDMI near table 3, bring miniDP->HDMI and USB-C->HDMI. Also power is 1x20A per cluster.

tara: I'm on speaker submissions — submitted 3 microsessions, one slot open at 11:20am. Who can present 'production inference economics' 15m lightning?

matt: I can do lightning but need SLAs on demo latency numbers. @eng-runtime any quick perf numbers for the quantized 7B?

sam (eng-runtime): 7B quantized endpoints: p95 latency ~ 120ms with batching off, we can demo 50ms warm cache. Happy to prep a one-slide stat.

lina: swag routing — propose split: 60% stickers, 20% shirts (S/M), 20% brochures+usb-c cards. We only have 45 shirts right now. Order 30 more? vendor leadtime 5 days.

anya: approve +30 shirts. Vendor: ThreadPrint. PO: TP-5567. matt pls confirm budget charge code.

matt: charge to MARKETING-OPS-Q2. I'll mark PO in Concur.

chris: AV checklist draft:
```
- bring miniDP->HDMI x2
- USB-C->HDMI x2
- power strip (surge) x3
- speaker mic (lapel) x1
- backup laptop with demo image
- ethernet dongle
```

tara: webinar follow-up plan: collect leads via QR -> redirect to /demo-signup -> auto email with calendar invite for 'Deep dive: inference cost controls' 1 week after demo day. Who owns the landing?

matt: I'll own landing + redirect. Can someone handle CSV export & CRM import after each demo? Prefer daily batch uploads.

sam: set up a cron to pull leads and `scp` to staging: `scp leads.csv rw-crm:/imports/uptown/`

anya: I'll be on-site noon-4 Wed and can supervise handoff. small ask: can someone set an SRE on-call for the kiosk to avoid reload issues? @eng-oncall

eng-oncall-bot: Incident duty rota reminder — @sam is on-call Tue-Wed. Use #eng-oncall for outages.

matt: noted. final: who wants to man the table slots? 2 people per slot: 10-1, 1-3, 3-5. volunteer list?

tara: I'll take 10-1

lina: 1-3 for me

chris: 3-5 me + sam

sam: can confirm after I check runway.

anya: perfect. I'll create calendar invites and a short one-pager for the staff with talking points + demo script. draft due EOD Mon.

matt: also ordering extra business cards — 250. Lina can pick up from warehouse.

lina: will do pickup Tue 4pm.

chris: heads up — vendor just pinged: foldable kiosk hinge delayed 24hrs. If it doesn't arrive by Wed morning we pivot to tabletop kit. inventory: hinge SKU HK-9 delayed.

matt: plan B acknowledged. pack tabletop kit too.

anya: thanks team. I'll post a final runbook here Mon morning. :rocket:
